review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and in a technical design review. What You'll Do ❏ Lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, current-state processes, and customer engagement requirements. ❏ Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, balancing configuration, low-code, and custom development. ❏ Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and data privacy requirements, including regional data residency where applicable.
